title.zh: 将标记赋值提升为切口模型端口标架
title.en: Lift marked values to cut-model port frames

given.zh: 已知初始标记图的边值种子 `producedCutSeed` 满足种子相容条件，切口索引选定为 `posSide`。
given.en: We are given the cut seed `producedCutSeed` satisfying seed compatibility at the chosen cut `posSide`.

claim.zh: 粘合后的标记边值构成切口模型赋值 `markedAsCutValues`，并在端口位置产生满足切口转移方程的端口标架 `parent_producedCutPortFrame`。
claim.en: The resulting marked values form cut-model values `markedAsCutValues` and yield a compatible cut port frame `parent_producedCutPortFrame`.

statement.zh: 存在切口模型数据使得 `producedMarkedValues` 等于 `external_markedAsCutValues` 给出的切口赋值。
statement.en: `producedMarkedValues` agrees with the cut-model values of `external_markedAsCutValues`.

statement.zh: 端口提升后的标架满足 `parent_markedLiftCutPortFrame`，从而得到目标端口标架方程 `parent_producedCutPortFrame`。
statement.en: The lifted port frame satisfies `parent_markedLiftCutPortFrame`, giving `parent_producedCutPortFrame`.

reason.zh: 将切口端点的局部标架代入 `parent_producedCutPortFrame` 即完成端口层面的相容性验证。
reason.en: Substituting the local cut-endpoint frame into `parent_producedCutPortFrame` establishes port-frame compatibility.

title.zh: 将切口边值转换到基点规范化表示
title.en: Rebase cut-model side values into a based gauge

given.zh: 由上一步已得切口模型赋值与端口标架 `parent_producedCutPortFrame`。
given.en: We have the cut-model values and port frame from `parent_producedCutPortFrame`.

claim.zh: 在基点规范下，每条标记边的矩阵值可表示为重标化提升 `parent_markedLiftSide_rebased`，给出标准化边值方程 `parent_producedMarkedSideValue`。
claim.en: Under the based gauge, each marked side value is given by the rebased lift `parent_markedLiftSide_rebased`, yielding `parent_producedMarkedSideValue`.

statement.zh: 重标化后的边提升与原始标记提升之间相差固定的基变换共轭，满足 `parent_markedLiftSide_rebased`。
statement.en: The rebased side lift matches the original marked lift up to the fixed basis change in `parent_markedLiftSide_rebased`.

reason.zh: 对应引理 `parent_markedLiftSide_rebased`，由局部标架的矩阵结合律直接化简。

statement.zh: 由此得到标准化边值等式 `parent_producedMarkedSideValue`，作为后续三组接缝的共同代数输入。
statement.en: This yields the normalized side-value formula `parent_producedMarkedSideValue`.

reason.zh: 对应引理 `parent_producedMarkedSideValue`，统一替换 `producedMarkedValues` 中的边取值。
reason.en: Proved in `parent_producedMarkedSideValue`, providing a uniform formula for side values.

title.zh: 验证未被剪开的旧接缝传递方程
title.en: Verify flag transport along unselected old seams

given.zh: 对 `graftPlus` 中未落入当前切口处的旧接缝 $s$，其相邻边值由基点规范边值 `parent_producedMarkedSideValue` 给出。
given.en: For an old seam $s$ of `graftPlus` away from the selected cut, its incident side values are given by `parent_producedMarkedSideValue`.

claim.zh: 父端与子逆端的标架传递分别满足 `external_oldParentTransport` 与 `external_oldChildInverseTransport`，汇总得到旧接缝相容性 `external_producedOldSeam_dataV2`。
claim.en: Parent and child-inverse transport satisfy `external_oldParentTransport` and `external_oldChildInverseTransport`, yielding old-seam compatibility `external_producedOldSeam_dataV2`.

statement.zh: 父端沿旧接缝的传递矩阵满足 `external_oldParentTransport`，而子端逆向传递满足 `external_oldChildInverseTransport`。
statement.en: Parent transport satisfies `external_oldParentTransport` and child inverse transport satisfies `external_oldChildInverseTransport`.

reason.zh: 对应引理 `external_oldParentTransport` 与 `external_oldChildInverseTransport`，抵消规范化共轭项。

statement.zh: 将两端传递与边值模板 `external_oldSeamFromValues` 组合，即证 `external_producedOldSeam_dataV2`。

reason.zh: 对应引理 `external_producedOldSeam_dataV2`，覆盖第一类接缝家族。
reason.en: Established by `external_producedOldSeam_dataV2`, completing the unselected old-seam family.

title.zh: 验证选定切口接缝的带旗标代数与完备性
title.en: Verify band-flag algebra and completeness on the selected cut seam

given.zh: 在选定切口 `posSide` 处，切口两侧由基点规范边值与剪开带上的新旗标衔接。
given.en: At the selected cut `posSide`, the two sides meet through the based-gauge side values and the new band flag.

claim.zh: 切口旗标满足矩阵恒等式 `parent_selectedFlag_algebra` 与 `parent_selectedBandFlag`，从而在带边值模板下导出完整的选定切口接缝 `parent_producedSelectedSeamComplete`。
claim.en: The cut flag satisfies `parent_selectedFlag_algebra` and `parent_selectedBandFlag`, establishing the selected cut seam `parent_producedSelectedSeamComplete`.

statement.zh: 利用 `parent_selectedSeam_fromSides` 将选定切口接缝归约为两侧归一化矩阵与切口带旗标的相容关系。
statement.en: Via `parent_selectedSeam_fromSides`, the selected cut seam reduces to compatibility between normalized side values and the band flag.

reason.zh: 对应引理 `parent_selectedSeam_fromSides`，分离出纯旗标矩阵部分。
reason.en: Established by `parent_selectedSeam_fromSides`, isolating the matrix flag identity.

statement.zh: 局部矩阵计算给出 `parent_selectedFlag_algebra` 与 `parent_selectedBandFlag`，从而推出 `parent_producedSelectedSeamComplete`。

reason.zh: 对应引理 `parent_producedSelectedSeamComplete`，同时也为后续短接缝与环绕接缝提供切口旗标恒等式。
reason.en: Proved in `parent_producedSelectedSeamComplete`; the resulting flag identity also supports the short and wrap seams.

title.zh: 验证剪开带上的原内接缝与镜像内接缝
title.en: Verify original and mirror internal seams on the grafted band

given.zh: 在剪开后插入的梯形带上，内部纵向边与镜像内部纵向边均取单位边赋值的规范形式。
given.en: Along the grafted band, both original internal edges and mirror internal edges carry unit-side normalized values.

claim.zh: 两类内部接缝分别满足 `external_originalInternalSeam` 与 `external_mirrorInternalSeam`，导出 `external_producedOriginalInternalSeam_data` 与 `external_producedMirrorInternalSeam_data`。
claim.en: Both internal seam families satisfy `external_originalInternalSeam` and `external_mirrorInternalSeam`, yielding `external_producedOriginalInternalSeam_data` and `external_producedMirrorInternalSeam_data`.

statement.zh: 利用 `external_unitSideSeam` 处理单位边上的旗标对齐，证得原内接缝方程 `external_originalInternalSeam` 与 `external_producedOriginalInternalSeam_data`。

reason.zh: 对应引理 `external_producedOriginalInternalSeam_data`，完成第三类接缝家族。
reason.en: Proved in `external_producedOriginalInternalSeam_data`, completing the third seam family.

statement.zh: 对镜像带上的对应内部边做对称置换，证得 `external_mirrorInternalSeam` 与 `external_producedMirrorInternalSeam_data`。
statement.en: Symmetrically on the mirror band, `external_mirrorInternalSeam` yields `external_producedMirrorInternalSeam_data`.

reason.zh: 对应引理 `external_producedMirrorInternalSeam_data`，完成第四类接缝家族。
reason.en: Proved in `external_producedMirrorInternalSeam_data`, completing the fourth seam family.

title.zh: 验证正负方向横截接缝的旗标相容性
title.en: Verify positive and negative transverse seam families

given.zh: 沿粘合带正方向与负方向横跨带面的横截接缝，连接端口标架与带端局部标记边。
given.en: Positive and negative transverse seams cross the grafted band, connecting port frames with band-end marked edges.

claim.zh: 正横截接缝与负横截接缝均满足通用横截接缝判据 `external_transverseSeam`，分别导出 `external_producedTransversePlus_dataSeam` 与 `external_producedTransverseMinus_dataSeam`。

statement.zh: 通用引理 `external_transverseSeam` 将任意横截接缝的旗标等式化归为带端端口标架的相容条件。
statement.en: The shared lemma `external_transverseSeam` reduces transverse seam equations to port-frame compatibility at band ends.

reason.zh: 对应引理 `external_transverseSeam`，统一正负两种横截定向。
reason.en: Proved in `external_transverseSeam`, factoring out the shared matrix algebra.

statement.zh: 分别代入正、负横截分支的数据，得到 `external_producedTransversePlus_dataSeam` 与 `external_producedTransverseMinus_dataSeam`。
statement.en: Instantiating the positive and negative branches yields `external_producedTransversePlus_dataSeam` and `external_producedTransverseMinus_dataSeam`.

reason.zh: 分别完成第五与第六类接缝家族。
reason.en: Completes the fifth and sixth seam families.

title.zh: 验证首段短接缝与闭合环绕接缝的旗标传递
title.en: Verify the first short seam and closing wrap seam via flag transport

given.zh: 已有基点规范化边值、切口端口标架 $P$ 以及选定切口处的带旗标关系。
given.en: We have the rebased side values, the cut port frame $P$, and the selected cut band-flag identity.

claim.zh: 首段短接缝满足 `external_producedFirstShortEquation_shared`，而闭合环绕接缝通过基变换传递矩阵 $T^{-1} J^{-1} P T$ 满足 `parent_producedWrapSeamComplete`。
claim.en: The first short seam satisfies `external_producedFirstShortEquation_shared`, while the closing wrap seam satisfies `parent_producedWrapSeamComplete` via the flag transport $T^{-1} J^{-1} P T$.

statement.zh: 由端口标架导出实际旗标 `external_firstActualFlagFromPortFrames_shared`，进而证明首段短接缝等式 `external_producedFirstShortEquation_shared`。
statement.en: Port frames yield `external_firstActualFlagFromPortFrames_shared`, proving the first short seam equation `external_producedFirstShortEquation_shared`.

reason.zh: 对应引理 `external_producedFirstShortEquation_shared`，完成第七类接缝家族。
reason.en: Proved in `external_producedFirstShortEquation_shared`, completing the seventh seam family.

statement.zh: 对闭合环绕接缝应用 `parent_wrapSeam_fromSides`，再结合 `parent_wrapFlag_algebra` 中的 $T^{-1} J^{-1} P T$ 共轭传递与 `parent_wrapUnitFlag`，得到 `parent_producedWrapFlag`。
statement.en: Applying `parent_wrapSeam_fromSides` together with the $T^{-1} J^{-1} P T$ transport in `parent_wrapFlag_algebra` and `parent_wrapUnitFlag` yields `parent_producedWrapFlag`.

statement.zh: 综合边值表达与环绕旗标等式，证得闭合环绕接缝的完备性 `parent_producedWrapSeamComplete`。
statement.en: Combining the side-value expansion and wrap flag identity proves `parent_producedWrapSeamComplete`.

reason.zh: 对应引理 `parent_producedWrapSeamComplete`，完成第八类也是最后一类接缝家族。
reason.en: Proved in `parent_producedWrapSeamComplete`, completing the eighth and final seam family.

title.zh: 通过八分支穷举完成全接缝主定理
title.en: Assemble all eight seam families into the main theorem

given.zh: 已分别证得 `graftPlus` 中未选旧接缝、选定切口接缝、原内接缝、镜像内接缝、正横截接缝、负横截接缝、首段短接缝与闭合环绕接缝共八个接缝家族的相容性。
given.en: We have established seam compatibility for all eight families of `graftPlus`: old, selected cut, original internal, mirror internal, positive/negative transverse, first short, and wrap seams.

claim.zh: 粘合图 `graftPlus` 上的赋值 `producedMarkedValues` 满足全部接缝方程，即主目标 `producedMarkedValues_allSeams` 成立。

statement.zh: 由 `external_graftPlus_cases` 得 `graftPlus` 的任意接缝 $s$ 必属于八类接缝构造子之一。
statement.en: By `external_graftPlus_cases`, every seam $s$ of `graftPlus` falls into one of the eight seam branches.

reason.zh: 穷举 `graftPlus` 的接缝列表定义，确保没有任何遗漏接缝。
reason.en: Exhausts the seam-list constructors of `graftPlus` with no missing cases.

statement.zh: 调用 `external_allSeamsFromBranches` 并传入前五步给出的八个分支定理，直接得到 `producedMarkedValues_allSeams`。
statement.en: Applying `external_allSeamsFromBranches` to the eight branch theorems proves `producedMarkedValues_allSeams`.
